list: Official PS5 trophy list (55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden) as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing on every name, description and grade.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. Everything is single-player and offline: no online or DLC trophies, no difficulty settings, and one playthrough is enough. Expect roughly 200 to 300 hours, most of it spent on the 100% completion checklist for A Long Road. Follow the roadmap in this guide: enjoy the story first, then work the 100% checklist, then clean up Strangers & Freaks and the remaining one-off trophies. Keep cheats off for the whole run, as using one disables trophies and saving.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Play the story (Stage 1) and pick up side content as it appears.
After the credits, work the 100% completion checklist (Stage 2).
Finish Strangers & Freaks and clean up anything left (Stage 3).
The platinum unlocks as soon as the 54th other trophy pops.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story and cannot be missed. Just keep following the main missions.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play through the opening missions of Chapter 1 until Gone Fishing completes.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. It pops once you have played the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so do not worry if it does not appear the instant the chapter ends. Unmissable: keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission, then start Chapter 2 with What's in the Bag?

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the mission Welcome to Vice City. Unmissable: keep playing the story. Note the name is shown on PlayStation with asterisks, exactly as listed here.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish every Chapter 2 story mission, then play Welcome to Vice City to open Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so keep playing a little past the chapter boundary. Unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Finish every Chapter 3 story mission, then play Ocean Beach and Another Life in Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through every Chapter 4 story mission to the end of the chapter.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the last mission of the game. Free roam carries on after the credits, so you can clean up every other trophy afterwards. There is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission, so there is nothing to fail here.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the story to its final mission and complete it.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run to completion.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist to completion.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Child's Play in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play to completion.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Headliners in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners to completion.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown to completion.

trophies.guide: Story trophy for Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It unlocks automatically as you play through the story and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory to completion.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the longest grind: roughly 100 hours of this stage alone. The 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. You do not need literally everything. Required in full: all robberies (including the 8 bank vaults and the 39 gang operations), underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. Only a share of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Work through the checklist methodically and tick off each category; most other trophies pop along the way.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to unlock the 100% checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion).
Clear the full requirements first: all robberies, 8 bank vaults, 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, all Shooting Range golds, all drone races, 15 Target Decks.
Then hit the partial counts: 100 optional missions, 200 vehicle scans, 100 animal studies, 15 meditations, 70 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans.

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to rack them up, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Track your count under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and show every Stunt Spot on the map. Note the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Open the map and show Stunt Spots (Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots).
Fly under bridges to build the count fast; mix in stunt jumps and base jumps.
Reach 250 stunts; continue to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Most of these come naturally while playing; check Progress > Activities to see what is left.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, arcade game, a race win, a stunt.
Check Progress > Activities for any type still missing.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges at two locations, Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to gold, and some are locked until you meet other conditions, which the map shows. Find ranges via Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit both ranges: Rodgers Ranch (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin (Balsero).
Gold every challenge across all three tiers; unlock gated ones as their conditions appear.
Track progress at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location properly while you are there. Some races charge an entry fee. Find locations via Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find all 14 Top Fun locations (Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones).
Win one race at each; run all three races per location for the 100% checklist.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from. Winning the same race again does not count. Track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. Most race locations let you hire a car; if you use your own, watch its Rating, which improves with upgrades from Mod Shops.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open Touch Pad > Activities > Racing to see the race list.
Win 20 different races; hire cars where offered or upgrade your own at Mod Shops.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After you meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge; early on he asks you to catch a Parrotfish over 2kg. You need a boat with a fishing rod, but there are plenty in the area you can take if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Meet Cal in Feng Shui (Chapter 1) and follow his texts to the marked fishing spot.
Fish the marked area until you land a Parrotfish over 2kg, then beat Cal in his challenge.

trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Pick whichever you find easiest and play it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Play an arcade game to its ending: at home on the TV, or Bang For Your Buck on a cabinet.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. The last one awards the trophy. They are still there after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: As Lucia in Chapter 3, follow Andy's text to Belville.
Complete his five missions in order, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. The final mission is Maritime Disputes. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Meet Kenton in Key Lento (Chapter 1) and recover treasure from the 7 shipwrecks.
Answer his later text to Jason and finish with Maritime Disputes.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy. They stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Billy's five jobs, ending with Hometown Heroes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed by guide sites, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list as you go. None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Complete stranger strands, starting with the confirmed ones: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Watch the trophy's progress counter to find the remaining qualifying strands.
Finish 8 in total; quest lines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look. Cars in better condition pay more.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: After Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Chapter 3), open Randy's Wish List.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK; deliver all 16 to his west Vice City garage.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: As Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3), destroy the purple-marked synthetic labs.
Complete Tyrone's last job, Shut Down the Labs.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it. This is the only trophy any guide flags as possibly missable.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth: follow Lucia to the balcony and meditate with her. Do not skip this.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), meditate at the remaining spots; meditating together counts twice.
Reach 18 meditations; check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so work through them all.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), answer Bret's text and start Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) as Jason; complete all 15 for 100%.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. There are 18 sets in the game, and the Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is. Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still contribute towards your progress. For 100% completion you will need 15 sets, so this trophy comes along the way.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards around Leonida; check Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards for set progress.
Complete any 3 full sets (15 sets are needed for 100%).

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Check progress under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this and the checklist line up.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1 / RB) at Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures and No Flusher tags.
Scan any 100 locations; track progress in Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 Challenges, in eight groups of ten. Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see all 80 and their requirements.
Complete any 50; keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2). Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape. It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well. Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner to join you.
Build a 4-star Wanted Level, then escape until you are out of the red heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together, which makes the run easier. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Stock up on body armor, sticky bombs and healing items; bring your partner.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level; the north Vice City jewelry stores are ideal.
Wait ~30 seconds after the third; rob a fourth if it has not popped.

trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. Vehicles also count as discovered when you get inside one. Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan passing traffic with the WAiNK app, or simply get inside new vehicles.
Reach 100 different vehicles; continue to 200 base models for 100%.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count. Raising your Focus level at Shooting Ranges helps.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Fill your Focus meter (eat, drink, wash up; Adrenaline extends it).
Find a group of gang operation thugs, trigger Combat Focus and drop 5 with an assault rifle.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA (Vice City International Airport), steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge; planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Enter VCIA and reach a passenger jet docked at a gate boarding bridge (E3/E4 are easiest).
Back the jet out, take off and fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base) and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Infiltrate Mile Zero Air Station (southwest island, Mariana County); tanks are at the south end.
Steal a Rhino tank and take out enemies from inside it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to get the Snap Gun.
Open a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun, find the safe code note, empty the safe unseen.

trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Unlock vaults via the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
Follow a security van to its bank; enter the vault while open and hand a bag to your partner.
Escape the 4-star heat on a fast bike; rob 5 vaults (all 8 for 100%).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before vaults are available, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Either rob a bank vault and escape the heat zone, or sticky-bomb an armored truck's back doors and get away.

trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Fly a plane over every fogged patch of the map until all of Leonida is revealed.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39 operations, so keep clearing them after this pops.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find yellow gang-operation icons on the map and rob one per gang (9 gangs).
Check Progress > Gangs for the count; clear all 39 for 100%.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. The exact steps were not confirmed by guide sites at the time of writing: the description points to ordering a cocktail at a beachfront bar overlooking Ocean Beach. Try the bars along the Ocean Beach front and look for a prompt to order a drink with a view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Head to Ocean Beach in Vice City and find a beachfront bar with a view.
Order and enjoy a cocktail there. Exact trigger unconfirmed at time of writing.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, a nod to the classic GTA opening. The exact steps were not confirmed by guide sites at the time of writing: drive a car into a vehicle showroom, then smash back out through its front window.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Drive a car into a vehicle showroom, then smash out through the front window. Exact trigger unconfirmed at time of writing.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back, so try to get them together.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn (marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling, Chapter 2).
Take the watch (SE office), the shotgun (NE table) and the safe (NE hallway; bring sticky bombs).
Lose the police to pop the trophy.

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Work out at fitness clubs with your partner along (training one trains both).
Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play normally; 500 Criminal Profile actions accumulate on their own.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI) to watch the count. Avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.guide: The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The exact steps were not confirmed by guide sites at the time of writing; it is most likely tied to retrying and passing something you failed once, such as a mission or an activity. Keep playing and retry anything you fail rather than reloading an old save.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Retry and pass something you failed on the first attempt. Exact trigger unconfirmed at time of writing.

trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. The exact steps were not confirmed by guide sites at the time of writing; this is most likely a scripted oddity or secret encounter you stumble on while exploring. Keep exploring unusual places and following strange prompts.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida and follow strange events or prompts. Exact trigger unconfirmed at time of writing.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle (a melee drive-by). The exact steps were not confirmed by guide sites at the time of writing: while driving, swing a melee weapon at pedestrians to bowl them over.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: From a moving vehicle, hit pedestrians with a melee attack. Exact trigger unconfirmed at time of writing.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there without extra grinding.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Complete Credit Check (Chapter 3) to get the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans; sell marked bills to fences (Yasmani pays most).
Reach $250,000 laundered in total.

trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest. It accumulates naturally over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across shops; guns, car mods and tattoos are fastest.

trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: After Daily Driver (Chapter 2), open the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 garages for sale (about $160,000 total).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app from Moses' Chapter 2 mission.
Take stolen vehicles to his Port Gellhorn garage, respray and register 10 of them.
Use cheap cars and bikes; keep free garage space.
